plan.summary: Projeler delivery-report drawer: a 'Rapor' button per project opens a wide right drawer with a run (gönderim) dropdown, a server-paged + phone-searchable per-recipient status table, a Resend button on undelivered (failed/ambiguous) rows, and a CSV export of ALL filtered rows. Read paths aggregate existing rows; resend re-queues the message in place via the existing worker (no new send-orchestration path).
plan.q_intent: projenin sağına bir rapor düğmesi ekle, sağdan drawer aç geniş geniş. içine her bir gönderim için dropdown ekle. ve bu filtreye uygun her numara için durumu ile beraber gösteren tablo ekle. search de ekle. her numara yanına gitmediyse hatayı yaz, resend düğmesi ekle. filtrelenmiş tablo için export to csv düğmesi koy.
plan.interview_notes: Q decisions: Resend ONLY on failed+ambiguous ('gitmeyenler'); CSV exports ALL filtered rows (not just the visible page). Summary counters stay PARTITION (Q chose 'partition kalsın') — the drawer shows each recipient's real status, the report is where delivered/read is visible per-number.

verification_questions.question: Is the recipients query tenant + project scoped so it can never list another tenant's or another project's outbound messages, and is the phone search injection-safe?
Does RequeueForResendAsync keep the broadcast counters partition-correct (old bucket --, queued ++) and refuse a message that is not failed/ambiguous or not one of this project's recipients?
Can the resend re-send a message that was actually delivered (double-send), or resend a recipient outside the eligible states, given the operator-initiated nature of resend?

forbidden_areas: BroadcastOrchestrator / MessageSenderService (the worker re-sends the re-queued row unchanged)
non_goals: A new resend send-orchestration path (re-queue reuses the worker)
intentional_exclusions: No migration (reads existing rows; reuses existing columns)
CSV export capped at the server's 5000 pageSize (well above the per-campaign hard cap)

try_catch_locations: ProjectsService.GetReportRunsAsync/GetReportRecipientsAsync/ResendAsync: typed NpgsqlException -> INV-OB-071; resend not-eligible -> INV-OB-090
ProjectsPage: per-call try/catch -> errText into the drawer error banner
user_facing_errors: drawer error banner for runs/recipients/resend/CSV failures
error_handling.silent_failure_explanation: Every backend path returns a typed code; the drawer surfaces failures in a red banner. The recipients useEffect uses a cancelled flag to avoid stale-state writes, not to swallow errors.

aha_moments.user_pain: Operators couldn't see WHY a campaign number didn't receive the message.
aha_moments.suggestion: Per-recipient status table with the exact failure reason inline.
aha_moments.aha_moment: The operator opens Rapor and instantly sees which numbers failed and why.

aha_moments.user_pain: A failed/ambiguous number had no recovery short of re-running the whole campaign.
aha_moments.suggestion: Per-row Resend that re-queues just that number via the worker.
aha_moments.aha_moment: One click re-sends the missed number; the row flips to Gönderildi.

aha_moments.user_pain: The same project ran multiple times and the operator couldn't tell the runs apart.
aha_moments.suggestion: A run dropdown (date + recipient count) filtering the table.
aha_moments.aha_moment: Selecting a run isolates exactly that send's recipients.

aha_moments.user_pain: Finding one number among thousands was impossible.
aha_moments.aha_moment: Typing a number jumps straight to its delivery status.

aha_moments.user_pain: Proving campaign delivery to a client required DB access.
aha_moments.suggestion: CSV export of all filtered rows with status + timestamps.
aha_moments.aha_moment: One CSV download is a shareable delivery report.
